crossRefs.note: Pray to Yahweh; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no…
crossRefs.keyword: gave up. Heb. shut up. hot thunderbolts. or, lightnings

translations.web: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
translations.bsb: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning.
translations.kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
translations.asv: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
